title: Eleven Cubic Metres
subtitle: 航天探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 航天探索（宇宙探索·宇航员与航天）
meta: 主题语境：航天探索（宇宙探索·宇航员与航天）　|　核心词汇：space　|　正文 285 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 space 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: For eleven months of my childhood I wanted to go into ① space, and my grandmother, who had never been further than the next valley, asked the only question that mattered: where would you put your things? She had a point. The ② living space on the station, as I later read, came to eleven cubic metres for two people, and was the only space they had.

③ In space, as every astronaut says, everything has to be tied down, including the things you would never think to tie down. My grandmother said she could have told them that. There is no ④ space up there for anything you have not decided about, which she said was true of a cottage as well.

My uncle became an engineer instead and worked for thirty-one years on the ⑤ space between two panels, which he said was the only part of the craft anybody ever argued about. It was eleven millimetres wide, it took eleven years to agree on, and the space is still there in the drawings.
The local paper gave the whole programme eleven ⑥ lines of space, on page nine, in 1979, and my grandmother cut it out and kept it in the Bible, which is where I found it in 2011.

⑦ In the space of eleven months I stopped wanting to go, and I never told anybody, and I have never been able to explain what changed. What I think changed was that I had begun to notice the ⑧ space in our own house: eleven rooms, one of them never used, which seemed to me then, and seems to me now, more ⑨ space than anybody needs, and which is the only ⑩ space I have ever wanted to be in.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 太空；外层空间
C. n. 空隙；间隔；间距
E. 固定搭配：in the space of ... 在……的时间里
F. 固定搭配：in space 在太空中
G. 固定搭配：living space 居住空间；生活面积
H. n. 空位；余地（no space for ...）

items.q: The living space on the station
In space, as every astronaut says
There is no space up there
on the space between two panels
In the space of eleven months
the space in our own house
the only space I have ever wanted to be in

answers.why: space 意为“太空、外层空间”，我童年有十一个月想去太空。
living space 意为“居住空间、生活面积”，空间站上两人的生活面积是十一立方米。
in space 意为“在太空中”，在太空中所有东西都必须固定住。
space 意为“空位、余地”，上面没有地方放你没有决定好的东西。
the space between ... 意为“……之间的空隙／间距”，他花了三十一年研究两块板之间那道缝。
space 意为“篇幅、版面”，当地报纸给了整个计划十一行的版面，登在第九版。
in the space of ... 意为“在……（不长）的时间里”，在十一个月之内我就不想去了。
the space 意为“空间、地方”，我开始留意自己家里的空间。
space 意为“余地、空处”，比任何人需要的都多。
space 意为“空间”，那是唯一一个我真正想待在里面的空间。
